name: Producer Pal
description: AI music production assistant for Ableton Live. Generate and edit MIDI clips, control playback, manage tracks, scenes, and the arrangement.
long_description:
To use: Add the Producer Pal device (Producer_Pal.amxd) to an empty MIDI track in Ableton Live. Ask Claude Desktop (with this extension enabled): "connect to ableton".
Requires Ableton Live 12.3+ with Max for Live (e.g. Ableton Live Suite).

mcp_server_origin.title: Ableton device URL
mcp_server_origin.description: URL for connecting to the Producer Pal Max for Live device (protocol://host:port). Use http://localhost:[port] for local connections or http://[IP]:[port] for network connections. The port number must match the port in the Max for Live device's advanced settings (default port is 3350). Default: http://localhost:3350

allow_configuration_overrides.title: Allow configuration overrides
allow_configuration_overrides.description: Off by default. While off, the settings below are ignored and Producer Pal uses whatever is configured on the Max for Live device and in the chat UI. Turn this on to let the settings below override the device — including forcing a setting off.

notation.title: MIDI notation
notation.description: Valid values are 'barbeat', 'stark', or 'midi-json'. Overrides the MIDI notation for reading and writing clips. 'barbeat' is recommended for Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable; use 'stark' with Small model mode, or 'midi-json' with JSON output. Leave blank, or enter anything else, to keep the device's current setting (barbeat by default). Requires Allow configuration overrides. Global device setting: also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients.

small_model_mode.title: Small model mode
small_model_mode.description: Requires Allow configuration overrides. Simplifies the tools and instructions for smaller models. May improve results with Claude Haiku; not recommended otherwise, since Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable handle the full toolset. Pairs well with MIDI notation set to 'stark'. Global device setting (also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients).

live_api.title: Direct Live API
live_api.description: Requires Allow configuration overrides. Enables the advanced ppal-live-api tool for direct access to the Ableton Live Object Model. An escape hatch for custom control, integrations, and debugging when Producer Pal's standard tools aren't enough — not recommended as a default. Global device setting (also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients).

json_output.title: JSON output
json_output.description: Requires Allow configuration overrides. Returns tool results as JSON instead of the compact default. Not recommended for normal use because it increases token usage, but useful when you want Claude to run code on the results. Pairs well with MIDI notation set to 'midi-json'.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Requires Allow configuration overrides. Keep only these tools, dropping the rest along with the instructions that teach them — a smaller ppal-connect response in every conversation. Comma-separated tool names ('read-clip' or 'ppal-read-clip') and/or groups: core, session, actions, live-set, track, scene, clip, device, advanced, read-only. Leave blank for all tools. ppal-connect is always kept. Applies to this extension only, unlike the settings above: the chat UI and other MCP clients keep the full toolset.

disable_tools.title: Disable tools
disable_tools.description: Requires Allow configuration overrides. Drop these tools, and the instructions that teach them, from every conversation. Same names and groups as Tools; applied after it. Leave blank to drop nothing. Applies to this extension only, unlike the global settings above.
